**Resubmitted — deviation (high), NONCOMPETE, preferred level.**

Change made in response to the verifier's minimality point: instead of substituting an affirmative permission (which duplicated § 12.3's existing operative freedom-of-action language), the proposal now simply strikes the prohibitory sentence in the second § 12.4, leaving "12.4 [Reserved.]" and relying on retained § 12.3.

- Validated `ok:true`, minimality clean.
- Preferred element ("Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction") mapped to operation 1.
- § 12.3 left intact and no longer contradicted; the non-solicitation sentence in the first § 12.4 untouched; no dangling cross-references (nothing elsewhere cites § 12.4).
- Narrowed 12-month named-product fallback offered in the comment only, as a negotiating position.
